items.content:
Sid texted a photo of her hand, bleeding, captioned "worth it." I looked
at it too long.

I don't know what I am. I know that when she talks I don't do the thing
where I shrink a little. That's new. I don't know if that's attraction or
just relief, and I'm not sure the difference matters as much as I was
raised to think it does.

summary: Sitting with new feelings for Sid and questioning what they mean
title: Considering whether I could
